decisions.summary: Knob 8 grove form (behind, behind and sides, sides, all around) with the ground rule, equal weights (guess), paddy edge OPEN with the GM; program, types.json notes and the shrine grove kind restated; owed list names the knob
decisions.why: Unchanged in the diff: FR-004, FR-007, FR-008. Not a narrowing, but D2's own text is now stale against amended D3: it says 'equal weights between two candidates', where knob 8 in programs.md (line 129) and research 129 now say 'between two or three'. The same stale 'which of two forms a slope takes is rolled' stands at HEAD in the shrine grove kind's Caveat (compound_kinds/grounds.py line 266) and the program's grove row (programs.md line 104) - wrong for Hoshigaoka itself, which rolled among three. FR-007 requires the kind's write-up updated to the new form: fix the Caveat, the row and D2's wording to 'two or three'.

decisions.summary: Amended: the hall is mid-slope with no break of slope (the map's one terrain datum is meta.down_deg 45), so it takes both slope classes' forms, a recorded guess; the roll choice(['behind','behind and sides','sides']) on crc32(b'hoshigaoka:shrine grove form') gave behind and sides
decisions.why: The premise is measured, not assumed: the manifest (legacy-hand-authored-pool/villages/hoshigaoka/hoshigaoka.json) carries no hill, summit or contour data, only meta.down_deg 45, so no break of slope is drawn at the hall and the survey's top-of-slope class was the unmeasured reading. The mid-slope rule fills a case the survey does not classify, is labeled a guess on research 129, knob 8 and the sheet's notes, and WIDENS the candidates rather than cutting any attested form - FR-004's 'what constrains the choice (the ground)' with a labeled gap-filler, not an exception to the request. Re-run for this review: the exact call gives 'behind and sides'. The form puts wood behind and on both sides, which the GM's question ('surrounded by trees on all sides?') leaves to the research; the research's answer (not always, on a slope) stands.

decisions.summary: Amended: one irregular region behind the hall from the well round both flanks to ragged tips beside the forecourt's foot, real bays and spurs, floor inside the crowns, lower approach open; captions reseated by make seat-label; one layout writes map fragment, manifest record and sheet tree list
decisions.why: FR-005 (sources silent on the plan, so irregular and labeled a guess), FR-006, FR-007: the region follows D3's form, and the bays and spurs answer the GM's 'very visually wrong' rectangle more fully than the plumb flanks did. Reseating captions the new wood covers is within FR-006's 'what the grove's new extent frees or covers'.

decisions.summary: Amended: frozen map edited by hand; the precinct's open ground and the bare strips north and south the old reservations left (settlement-review F3) carry the map's own grass tufts and shrub dots from the open ground just west, no pines; the notes row records the wood once
decisions.why: FR-006 allows the scrub where the wood leaves or arrives. The strips are the old grove box's footprint showing in the scrub (the notes row and map_edit.py line 65 say so; sr1-f3 records the density brought to the neighboring field's), i.e. ground the old drawing held and the new extent frees, not a new change elsewhere on the map. Leaving out the donor's pines is a drawing choice (tiled pines read as a grid), not a requested behavior dropped.

decisions.summary: Amended: sheet frame widened to the wood's crowns; subtitle's 'in its wood' dropped; the Grove form line as the program declares it; the precinct's open ground plain on the sheet where the map draws scrub, recorded as a map drawing convention; every grove text restated (R3 ledger)
decisions.why: FR-007: the sheet matches the map's grove tree for tree; the scrub is not the grove, so drawing it plain and labeling that a map drawing convention is a labeled rendering decision (constitution XII), not a mismatch. The Grove form line writes the knob FR-004 declares. The one stale grove text this review found (the kind's Caveat, 'two forms') is carried under D2.
